description: Minimal portable bundle from which a stranger can regenerate one Evalwarden integrity card using only public inputs. If any input cannot be public, the pack is invalid and the registry concept fails for that card.

audit_result.description: The full machine-readable audit output, embedded so a stranger can diff findings without re-running anything.

result.description: Exact JSON emitted by the audit command for this artifact.

sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON serialization of 'result'.

definition_source.description: Which task definition was audited, e.g. 'inspect_evals/healthbench'.

version.description: Benchmark version or snapshot date as published.

rule.description: Exact, implementable rule, e.g. 'remove the <footer>...</footer> block containing the generation timestamp before hashing'.

cost_summary.description: Cost summary when runs exist. Must be explicit null (not omitted) when there are no runs.

cost_summary_absent_reason.description: Required when cost_summary is null, e.g. 'no_run_records'.

created_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of pack authoring. Informational only; never part of any hash.

sha256.description: sha256 of the card HTML AFTER canonicalization.

install.description: Public install command, e.g. 'pip install evalwarden==0.6.1'.

python.description: Python version the pack was authored under, e.g. '3.11'. Advisory.

version.description: Exact pinned version, e.g. '0.6.1'. The expected card hash is only valid for this version.

inputs.description: Every byte the regeneration needs, pinned. No input may require auth or a private URL.

fetch_note.description: How the bytes are obtained, e.g. 'first 12 JSONL records via ranged reads'.

location.description: Repo URL, HTTPS URL, or raw-file URL. Must be public.

pin.description: How the input is pinned. Git inputs pin a full commit SHA; content inputs pin content_sha256 of the exact fetched bytes. Canonical serialization for hashing: JSON with keys sorted, compact separators (',', ':'), UTF-8 encoding. The pack author and the verifier must use the same canonical form; a mismatch fails the check rather than silently passing.

paths.description: For git inputs: the exact files read.

public.description: Must be true. A false here kills the pack.

role.description: What this input is for: 'task_definition' | 'dataset_sample' | 'builder' | 'grader_template' | other.

question.const: can a stranger regenerate this card from public inputs?

status.description: 'unverified' at pack authoring; set by the verifier after a stranger-run.

pack_id.description: Stable card identifier, e.g. 'healthbench-via-inspect-evals'. Matches the card filename stem.

command.description: One shell command a stranger pastes into a fresh machine. Fetches the verifier and runs it; the verifier does everything else from the pack alone.

runs.description: Pointers to raw run records (trace URIs, run IDs). Empty when the card is definition-level.

runs_coverage_note.description: Required when runs is empty: states what the card cannot say without run records (e.g. which checks stay silent).

schema_version.description: Bump on any breaking change to pack semantics.

task_manifest.description: Hash of the translated artifact directory exactly as the auditor saw it (dataset.json, environment.json, grader.json, PROVENANCE.json). Canonical form: JSON object mapping relative path -> sha256 of file bytes, keys sorted, serialized with sort_keys and no whitespace beyond separators.

files.description: relative path -> sha256 of file bytes

excluded.description: Material deliberately left out of the translated artifact, with reasons. The integrity question is what the agent can see, so public-but-harness-side material (gold patches, test patches) is excluded and the exclusion is documented here.

title: Evidence Pack v1
